title: P1 memory.propose: request
description: Proposal of a memory item of the person scope by a memory handle; the item becomes active only after the decision of the person whose memory it is (P1 decide, subject memory_record, MEM-3). With untrusted_seen of the attempt, the denial memory_untrusted. Idempotent by the hash of {key, content} (spec/hashing.md).
